title: Sign-in blocked by access policy

support.label: no bad-password failures in cloud sign-ins

next_steps: Do not reset the password for {account}. A wrong password is not what stopped these sign-ins.
Check that you are signing in to {top_app} the approved way: a managed device, the approved app, and from an expected location.
If {account} is a service or automation account, raise a request with the identity team to review how it should authenticate. Do not look for a workaround.
If the sign-ins were not you or your system, contact the CSOC.
